theme.title: Bird's best Celtics
theme.subtitle: Boston, 1985–86
theme.recap: Larry Bird won a third straight MVP, Boston lost once at home all season and the Celtics beat Houston for the title.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 1985–86 Celtics win?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They finished with the best record in the league at 67–15, including a 40–1 record at home

funFacts.text: Boston's Garden-era home dominance was extraordinary: the team lost only once at home all regular season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: including a 40–1 record at home (37–1 at the Boston Garden, 3–0 at the Hartford Civic Center)

funFacts.text: Bill Walton won Sixth Man of the Year as a reserve behind Bird, Parish and McHale.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bill Walton won the Sixth Man of the Year Award

funFacts.text: Larry Bird collected a third straight league MVP award during the championship season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Larry Bird won his third consecutive MVP award

questions.prompt: Michael Jordan set a playoff scoring record against the 1986 Celtics in a loss. How many points did he score?
questions.note: 63 points, a playoff record, in a Bulls loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Michael Jordan (63)

funFacts.text: Chicago needed two overtimes to settle the record-setting game in Boston, but the Celtics held on.
Charles Oakley led the Bulls on the glass that night, pulling down fourteen rebounds.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Charles Oakley (14)

funFacts.text: Boston Garden drew a crowd of 14,890 for that historic first-round playoff game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston Garden 14,890

questions.prompt: Boston routed Atlanta 132–99 in the 1986 East semifinals. How many points did the Hawks score in the third quarter?
questions.note: Six, as Boston won the quarter 36–6.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston outscored Atlanta 36–6 in the third quarter in route to a 132–99 victory.

funFacts.text: Before that Hawks blowout, Boston had already swept Michael Jordan's Bulls in the first round.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston needed just three games to defeat the Chicago Bulls in the first round

funFacts.text: The Celtics subsequently swept Milwaukee to reach the championship round without a conference-finals loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: in the conference finals, Boston swept the Milwaukee Bucks in four games

funFacts.text: That season's championship series marked the first official use of the 'NBA Finals' branding.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: this series marked the first time the "NBA Finals" branding was officially used

questions.prompt: In the 1985–86 opener, Larry Bird posted a triple-double. How many steals did he add?
questions.context: Celtics at New Jersey Nets · October 25, 1985
questions.note: Eight steals, with 21 points, 12 rebounds and 10 assists.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: recorded 21 points, 12 rebounds, 10 assists and 8 steals for the Celtics

funFacts.text: Bird's near quadruple-double happened in an overtime defeat against New Jersey, not a Celtics victory.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They started their 1985–86 season campaign with a 109-113 OT loss to the New Jersey Nets

funFacts.text: Bird also logged a triple-double in points, rebounds and assists during that opening-night thriller.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bird, who recorded 21 points, 12 rebounds, 10 assists and 8 steals

funFacts.text: Boston's four headliners—Bird, McHale, Parish and Johnson—all reached twenty points in a win over Milwaukee.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bird, McHale, Parish and Johnson, all scoring at least 20 points

questions.prompt: Of the 288 possible minutes in the six-game 1986 Finals, how many did Larry Bird play?
questions.context: 1986 NBA Finals · six games vs Houston
questions.note: 269, resting for only 19 minutes all series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bird got very little rest during the six-game series, logging 269 out of a possible 288 minutes of floor time.

funFacts.text: Scott Wedman's wrist injury reduced Boston's wing depth and helped explain Bird's huge Finals workload.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: With backup forward Scott Wedman sidelined due to a wrist injury

funFacts.text: Reserve Bill Walton made a crucial basket late in Game 4 while Robert Parish rested.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: with Bill Walton coming off the bench for a tired Robert Parish to score a crucial basket

funFacts.text: The fifth Finals game erupted when Ralph Sampson clashed with the much shorter Jerry Sichting and was ejected.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Ralph Sampson ignited a brawl with Jerry Sichting, a player 15 inches (380 mm) shorter than Sampson
